tldr: Mercury through the 12th house brings focus to rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat.
body: Mercury transiting the 12th house activates rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat. For a few weeks, thought, conversation, planning, and messages move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a thinking transit: it favors planning, conversations, edits, decisions, and information-gathering around the house topic.
business: Mercury supports private healing and release: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Overthinking, mixed messages, or escape, isolation, or avoiding what needs care.
advice: Name the details in the 12th house deliberately. Work with rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
